01

Daily Rotation

Repeatable systems players check each day
01🏰

Dungeons

At 600 power rating, Solo Dungeons become available through Instance Systems. Dungeon boost from daily rewards can power up the run.

02📜

Daily Tasks

The top-right menu provides 10 different hunting tasks every 24 hours and shows the reset time.

03🔥

Ritual Lord

Lord Rituals require Awakening 300+ and use gold sacrifice for more lootbags.

04⚔

Champion Arena

Awakening 150+ daily arena entered through the Arena Master in depot level 3.

05⚒

Profession Tasks

Profession tasks are available every 24 hours at depot basement and give strong daily crafting experience.

06🌀

Rift Tasks

Rift monster tasks reward Rift Shards used for relics, experience boosts, and addon items.

03

Profession and Rift Tasks

Crafting and rift shard loop

Daily Profession Tasks are found at depot -1. First-time craft bonus is 400%, while the daily bonus is 200%. At 60, 70, 80, 90, and 95 profession level, profession enhancements become available.

Rift tasks are taken for Rift monsters and completed for Rift Shards, which can be traded for relics, experience boosts, and addon items.
